optimized_sql:
SELECT substr(r.r_reason_desc,1,20), AVG(ws.ws_quantity), AVG(wr.wr_refunded_cash), AVG(wr.wr_fee)
FROM web_sales ws
JOIN web_returns wr ON ws.ws_item_sk = wr.wr_item_sk AND ws.ws_order_number = wr.wr_order_number
JOIN web_page wp ON ws.ws_web_page_sk = wp.wp_web_page_sk
JOIN date_dim d ON ws.ws_sold_date_sk = d.d_date_sk
JOIN reason r ON r.r_reason_sk = wr.wr_reason_sk
JOIN (
    SELECT cd_demo_sk, cd_marital_status, cd_education_status
    FROM customer_demographics
    WHERE (cd_marital_status, cd_education_status) IN (('D','Primary'), ('S','College'), ('U','Advanced Degree'))
) cd1 ON cd1.cd_demo_sk = wr.wr_refunded_cdemo_sk
JOIN (
    SELECT cd_demo_sk, cd_marital_status, cd_education_status
    FROM customer_demographics
    WHERE (cd_marital_status, cd_education_status) IN (('D','Primary'), ('S','College'), ('U','Advanced Degree'))
) cd2 ON cd2.cd_demo_sk = wr.wr_returning_cdemo_sk
JOIN (
    SELECT ca_address_sk, ca_state
    FROM customer_address
    WHERE ca_country = 'United States'
      AND ca_state IN ('NC', 'TX', 'IA', 'WI', 'WV', 'GA', 'OK', 'VA', 'KY')
) ca ON ca.ca_address_sk = wr.wr_refunded_addr_sk
WHERE d.d_year = 1998
  AND cd1.cd_marital_status = cd2.cd_marital_status
  AND cd1.cd_education_status = cd2.cd_education_status
  AND CASE
        WHEN cd1.cd_marital_status = 'D' AND cd1.cd_education_status = 'Primary' AND ws.ws_sales_price BETWEEN 100.00 AND 150.00 THEN 1
        WHEN cd1.cd_marital_status = 'S' AND cd1.cd_education_status = 'College' AND ws.ws_sales_price BETWEEN 50.00 AND 100.00 THEN 1
        WHEN cd1.cd_marital_status = 'U' AND cd1.cd_education_status = 'Advanced Degree' AND ws.ws_sales_price BETWEEN 150.00 AND 200.00 THEN 1
        ELSE 0
      END = 1
  AND CASE
        WHEN ca.ca_state IN ('NC', 'TX', 'IA') AND ws.ws_net_profit BETWEEN 100 AND 200 THEN 1
        WHEN ca.ca_state IN ('WI', 'WV', 'GA') AND ws.ws_net_profit BETWEEN 150 AND 300 THEN 1
        WHEN ca.ca_state IN ('OK', 'VA', 'KY') AND ws.ws_net_profit BETWEEN 50 AND 250 THEN 1
        ELSE 0
      END = 1
GROUP BY r.r_reason_desc
ORDER BY substr(r.r_reason_desc,1,20), AVG(ws.ws_quantity), AVG(wr.wr_refunded_cash), AVG(wr.wr_fee)
LIMIT 100
